summary: The long-video feed was down to 2 usable topics, so I added 3 global ones: airlines' card money (7.4M reference), the middle-class traps (10.1M) and the levels of wealth (5.0M). I also studied where our long videos lose viewers, and routed one adopt and two experiments.
why: Studio needs at least 4 usable topics, and it still has 2 long videos to make this week. Our long videos lose the average viewer around 1:48, inside a first chapter that runs 85–95 s.

findings.title: The first chapter runs 85–95 s, and the average viewer leaves inside it
findings.detail: In L-20261023-01, the average view is 21.6% of 499 s, about 1:48. Its chapter 1 runs 0:28–1:53. That's only 6 views, so it's a hint.

findings.title: The intro reads out every chapter name
findings.detail: L-20261026-01 names all six moves at 0:12, which closes the open loops.

findings.title: Recaps are still late
findings.detail: The first recap is at 3:25. The 2026-10-23 adopt asked for 2:30.

changes.title: 3 backlog items, 2 updated
changes.detail: adopt first-chapter-60s (high). Experiments no-table-of-contents and early-spike. chapter-hold-metric raised to high.
